# Primis Bank Launches Redesigned Website Built for What’s Next


Author: Primis


| Published: Friday, September 25, 2026


---


**RICHMOND, Va., Sept. 25, 2026 —** Primis Bank announced the launch of its redesigned website this week, introducing a modern, streamlined experience that makes it easier for customers to explore products, find helpful information and better understand what makes Primis different.


More than a new look, the redesigned PrimisBank.com represents an investment in making banking simpler and more intuitive. Clearer navigation, improved product exploration and more accessible information help customers connect more quickly with the products, services and support they need.


“Our new website is about much more than changing how Primis looks online. It’s about building a better foundation for how we serve our customers digitally,” said Ann-Stanton Gore, chief strategy officer of Primis Bank. “This is the first of several investments focused on making banking simpler, more connected and more efficient. As our customers’ expectations continue to evolve, we want the experiences we build to evolve with them and give us the flexibility to keep making banking better.”


Behind the new customer experience is an equally important investment in technology. Primis moved its website to Xperience by Kentico, providing a more scalable platform with stronger content governance and the ability to manage multiple brands and digital properties within one content management system. The new platform will allow Primis to introduce improvements more efficiently and support more connected digital experiences as the bank continues to grow.


The launch is part of Primis Bank’s broader investment in technology and experiences designed to make banking simpler for customers.


Visit PrimisBank.com to explore the new experience.


---


Primis Bank (Member FDIC) is a high-growth, forward-thinking bank committed to building a better banking experience for consumers, businesses, and communities. With industry-leading digital tools, a relentless focus on customer care, and a culture built around doing things the right way—not the easy way—Primis continues to invest in growth, innovation, and people.
